name: Calendly

tiers.how: Sage connects to Calendly via the official Calendly v2 REST API using a Personal Access Token (or OAuth 2.0) stored in the OS credential store. The owner must generate a Personal Access Token in Calendly's Integrations settings and store it via setup_creds. New bookings can trigger Sage's lead intake flow via Calendly webhook, which requires a public HTTPS endpoint.
writes: cancellations of existing events (on behalf of the owner)
always_tap: any cancellation of a client appointment initiated by Sage

gotchas: Calendly webhooks require a public HTTPS endpoint; use Tailscale Funnel or a VPS reverse proxy.
Cancellations via the Calendly API automatically send notification emails to the invitee; always require an approval tap before canceling.
The free Calendly plan limits event types and active scheduling links; verify the subscription tier.
Calendly is now owned by Calendly Inc.; the API at developer.calendly.com is the canonical reference.
notes: Calendly is a self-serve scheduling tool; the owner configures availability and event types, and Sage reads new bookings to trigger intake flows.
